answer.rationale: Primary lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line runs at 94% with no buffer, so deferral or only adding a second source would leave primary uncovered and raise delivery risk. The low-cost quote can meet the 18% cut and c2 reports a clean prior switch, but a primary changeover still increases interruption risk the objective forbids. c1 and c6 favor keeping the incumbent for integration stability and volume pricing; c4 says benchmarking at renewal moved that incumbent on price and terms. Intend to negotiate the expiring contract against the low-cost quote (verify c4). Whether an 18% gap closes in 14 days is still uncertain.
